sloka: संप्रति एतावत् एव अद्य शक्यम् मे गमने स्वतः ।न एतावता च संसिद्धिः कार्यस्य अस्य भविष्यति ॥४-६५-१७॥
transliteration: saṁprati etāvat eva adya śakyam me gamane svataḥ ।na etāvatā ca saṁsiddhiḥ kāryasya asya bhaviṣyati ॥4-65-17॥

translations.english: 'I guess that at this time I do not have the capacity to fly to that extent. Achieving the objective is out of question with this much of energy.
translations.hindi: मेरे एक-पति-त्रत को कोन नष्ट करना चाहता है उसके इस प्रश्न के उत्तर में बायु ने कहा
